faq.question: What does active CPU hour mean?
faq.answer: You are billed based on how much CPU your code actually consumes, measured in core-hours. For example, using 100% of 2 cores for one hour costs $0.2, while using 10% of a single core for one hour costs $0.01. When a standard box is idle with no CPU usage, no charges apply. Keep-alive boxes use fixed monthly pricing by size instead.

faq.question: What happens when a box is idle?
faq.answer: Standard boxes automatically freeze after inactivity. Storage is preserved, but running processes are stopped until the next request. When a new request comes in, the box wakes up automatically, similar to how AWS Lambda cold-starts on demand. No manual intervention is needed. Keep-alive boxes stay on continuously and use fixed monthly pricing by size instead of auto-pause behavior.

faq.question: How much do Keep Alive boxes cost?
faq.answer: Keep Alive boxes are billed with a fixed monthly price by size. This is the only charge for that Keep Alive box, so you are not billed separately for CPU or storage on it. Small costs $8/month, Medium costs $16/month, and Large costs $32/month.

faq.question: What is included in storage billing?
faq.answer: Storage is billed at $0.1 per GB per month and includes all data on disk, including snapshots. Storage limits are 10 GB for Small, 20 GB for Medium, and 30 GB for Large.

faq.question: What are the free tier limits?
faq.answer: The free tier includes up to 10 concurrent boxes and 5 CPU hours per month. Agents use your own model provider key.

faq.question: How is model usage billed?
faq.answer: Agents use your own model provider key (Anthropic, OpenAI, OpenRouter, ...). Set it on the box or save it on your account. Upstash does not provide or bill model usage. Agent runs, scheduled runs and browser AI calls need a key. Shell, files, git, SSH, previews and browser CDP work without one.

faq.question: Can I run more than 1,000 concurrent boxes?
faq.answer: Yes. The default quota for Pay as you go is 1,000 concurrent boxes. This is a soft limit that can be increased on request, similar to AWS service quotas. Just contact us and we'll raise your limit.

faq.question: Where are boxes hosted?
faq.answer: Boxes currently run on AWS us-east-1. We are planning to add more regions soon.

faq.question: Can I use my own Docker container?
faq.answer: Yes, custom Docker container support is planned and coming soon.
